items: [Wrapping] words are split on any whitespace; runs collapse
[Wrapping] greedy fill: a word joins the line if line + space + word fits `width`
[Wrapping] a word longer than `width` is alone on its line, unbroken
[Wrapping] lines have no leading or trailing spaces
[Wrapping] text with no words gives an empty vector
[Counting] a word is a maximal run of non-whitespace characters
[Counting] tabs and newlines separate words (Unicode whitespace)
[Counting] punctuation inside a run does not split it
